description: You need to use KA documents folder any question related to the recipe guidelines or rules

content: For recipes, drink preparation, decoction, barista procedures, equipment cleaning, food safety, allergens, franchise questions, and supplier contract terms (minimum orders, payment, delivery terms): answer from the documents in the attached volume (drink_recipes_sop.pdf, barista_training_manual.pdf, equipment_maintenance_guide.pdf, food_safety_policy.pdf, franchise_operations_guide.pdf, supplier_agreements_summary.pdf) and cite the document.Combine sources when useful: e.g. supplier lead time from the suppliers table plus minimum order and payment terms from supplier_agreements_summary.pdf.Completeness rule for document answers: store managers act on these answers without opening the PDF, so include every operational detail the documents state for the item asked about — for drinks: the menu price along with the recipe; for suppliers: lead time, minimum order quantity, delivery schedule and payment terms; for perishables: storage temperature AND the use-by window after delivery or preparation.
